from pathlib import Path
import collections
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u066/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=program_dir/'task-ce20be4c.py'
source='''from collections import Counter

def _mode(row):
    return Counter(row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_modes = [_mode(row) for row in grid]
    col_modes = [_mode([grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]) for c in range(w)]
    # The separator color is the less frequent of the modal row/column colors.
    row_counts, col_counts = Counter(row_modes), Counter(col_modes)
    row_line = min(row_counts, key=row_counts.get)
    col_line = min(col_counts, key=col_counts.get)
    rows = [r for r, color in enumerate(row_modes) if color == row_line]
    cols = [c for c, color in enumerate(col_modes) if color == col_line]
    # At grid crossings, a non-separator color is a marker. Crop to their bounds.
    marks = [(i, j) for i, r in enumerate(rows) for j, c in enumerate(cols)
             if grid[r][c] != row_line]
    if not marks:
        return []
    r0 = min(i for i, _ in marks); r1 = max(i for i, _ in marks)
    c0 = min(j for _, j in marks); c1 = max(j for _, j in marks)
    interior = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
                       if r not in rows and c not in cols).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[interior for _ in range(c1-c0)] for _ in range(r1-r0)]
    for i in range(r0, r1):
        for j in range(c0, c1):
            vals = [grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j+1]],
                    grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i+1]][cols[j+1]]]
            if vals[0] != row_line and all(v == vals[0] for v in vals):
                out[i-r0][j-c0] = vals[0]
    return out
'''
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
